log10 of the label requires one
a generous letter-count bound; the true <= 50-residue limit is applied on parsed residues by build_strict_peptide_set.py
curated design and animal_dosed, which recover the study design from the sample text
a cultured-cell assay is not the animal
PEPlife2's own repeated transcriptions of one measurement
a defect no structural gate can see; see CURATED_EXCLUSIONS
organ-ablated, knockout, transgenic and disease-model animals, and tissue, lysate or lymph samples, are not normal plasma elimination

longer chains are proteins in a different clearance regime
any record whose name, termini or modifications name or leave unresolved an attached partner (carrier, dye, drug, protein or polymer)
absorption, distribution and activity half-lives; no value magnitude cutoff is applied
the SMILES could not be built, or the emitted string contradicts the sequence it was built from, or its conjugate mass delta is wrong
preserve source IDs; review possible repeats using full experimental context
